title: Call script: front desk to practice manager
body:
DIAL (718) 266-0900 (Sorin Medical, 150 55th St)
GOAL: find who owns patient materials, offer printed copies, get a name and email. No pitch on this call.

"Hi, this is Xander from FlocCare. I emailed Dr. Puma a free one-page diabetes-and-heart handout in Spanish, Chinese and English with the practice name on it. Who handles patient handouts there, you or the practice manager?"
If manager: "Could I mail a few printed copies? Who should I address them to?"
If 'send it to the doctor': "Will do. Is email or paper easier for Dr. Puma?"
CAPTURE: name, role, email, best time, languages patients ask for most.

VOICEMAIL (20 sec): "Hi, Xander from FlocCare. I sent Dr. Puma a free one-page diabetes-and-heart handout in Spanish, Chinese and English with the practice name on it. I'll mail a few printed copies this week. (555) 010-0175. Thanks."
